strings.step2_title: Place your lights in the room
strings.step3_title: Let the lights follow the screen
strings.feel_instant_tip: Follows every cut. For fast games.
strings.sound_delay_tip: If the lights land before the beat you hear, as with Bluetooth headphones or a TV's speakers, hold them back by that much: about 200 ms for Bluetooth. Below zero, they go earlier still.
strings.flashes_tip: Short white flashes when the music drops, never in a gentle track and never more than three a second, even with the photosensitivity protection off.
strings.select_all_tip: The settings go to every light. Click lights to set only those.
strings.scene_save_tip: Saves what every light does now, to bring it back in one click.
strings.scene_replace_tip: {name} will be replaced by what the lights do now.
strings.scenes_empty: Save what every light does now, then bring it back in one click.
strings.bright_shared: Also changes {names}: an effect has one brightness for every light playing it.
strings.all_off_tip: Also stops the effects, Screen included
strings.screen_lost: Can't read the screen. The lights keep their colour until it's back.
strings.hdr_tip: Your screen is in HDR. Lueur reads the colours Windows composes and matches them to the SDR content brightness set in Windows.
strings.mood_natural_tip: Follows the time of day: cool and bright by day, warm and low in the evening.
strings.sleep_timer_tip: Turns off every light in the room, whichever are picked. They fade out over the last minute.
strings.sleep_keep_on: Leave the computer on until then.
strings.sleep_stays_open: Lueur stays open, even with the window closed.
strings.click_to_extend: Click to play it on every light picked
strings.walls_tip: Lueur corrects every light for it, so the room shows the colours you asked for, not the paint's.
strings.auto_mode_tip: Starts by itself when a game or a video goes fullscreen, and gives your lights back when it ends.
strings.coach: Drag each light to where it stands, and You to your seat.
strings.plan_help: Double-click a wall to add a corner
strings.seat_title: Your seat. Drag to turn the screen.
strings.screen_hint: Drag You on the plan to turn the screen towards your seat.
strings.facts_tip: Further from the screen, light is softer and slower, like real bounced light.
strings.identify_tip: Flash it warm white, to spot it
strings.plan_label: Room plan. Every object on it is in the list beside it, where you can select and place it.
strings.pos_tip: In plan units: X from {min} to {maxX}, Y from {min} to {maxY}. The screen is {w} wide.
strings.update_ready: Version {version} is installed. Restart Lueur to apply it.
strings.first_text: Lueur finds Yeelight, Hue, WiZ, LIFX, Govee and Nanoleaf on this network.
strings.unassign_tip: The light stays in the room, without this bulb
strings.tip_1: Yeelight and Govee: turn on LAN Control in their app.
strings.tip_2: Use the same network as this computer, not a guest network.
strings.tip_3: Allow Lueur through the firewall when Windows asks.
strings.tip_4: Smart Life bulbs shared with you one by one cannot be imported: ask their owner to add you to their home.
strings.tip_5: Supported: Yeelight, Philips Hue, WiZ, LIFX, Govee, Nanoleaf and Smart Life (Tuya).
strings.pair_faster: pair it again so its lamps keep up with the music
strings.pair_faster_tip: Paired with an older Lueur: its lamps take a few commands a second. Paired again, it streams to them, quick enough to punch the beat.
strings.pair_hue: Press the round button in the middle of the Hue bridge.
strings.pair_nanoleaf: Hold the controller's power button for 5 to 7 seconds, until its lights flash.
strings.pair_why: Lueur needs the bridge's permission, once. Pressing its button gives it.
strings.pair_why_nanoleaf: Lueur needs the controller's permission, once. Holding its button gives it.
strings.paired: {name} is paired. Its bulbs now appear in the list below.
strings.pair_expired: The button was not pressed within 30 seconds. Nothing changed: you can try again.
strings.copy_tip: Copy the message and its details, to send them to someone who can help
strings.tuya_code_help: In Smart Life: Me, then the gear, then Account and Security, then User Code.
strings.tuya_scan: In Smart Life, tap the scan button at the top of Home, scan this code and confirm.
strings.tuya_none: No colour bulb in this Smart Life account.
strings.tuya_expired: The QR code was not scanned within 3 minutes, so it expired. Press Continue for a new one.
strings.tuya_code_empty: Type the user code shown in Smart Life first.
strings.tuya_code_short: This code is too short. Check it in Smart Life and type it again in full.
strings.tuya_code_chars: A user code holds only unaccented letters and digits. Check it in Smart Life.
strings.tuya_adding: Bulbs imported. Looking for them on your network…
strings.tuya_hint: Smart Life bulbs only show up here once imported with your Smart Life account.
strings.tuya_already: Your Smart Life bulbs are already in your room.
strings.tuya_qr: QR code to scan in Smart Life
strings.tuya_missing: Some bulbs did not answer. Check that they are switched on, then search again.
strings.sound_source_tip: What the Music effect follows. The default output follows Windows when it changes. An application shows up here once it has played sound since it opened.
strings.frame_rate_tip: Higher follows the screen more closely, for a little more processor time. 45 suits most bulbs.
strings.colour_strength_tip: How much the lights strengthen the picture's colours. Bulbs and LEDs tend to wash out a screen's colours; a little extra brings them back. At 0 the lights take the colours as they are.
strings.dark_scenes_tip: How much a dark picture lights the room. Lit keeps some light on even in a night scene. As on screen gives the room the same share of light as the screen gives, so dark scenes leave it dark.
strings.config_file_tip: Room, bulbs and settings, to keep a copy or move to another computer. No password or key goes in the file: on the other computer, pair the bridges and import Smart Life again.
strings.logs_tip: What Lueur did, to attach to a bug report. They hold no password or key.
strings.no_bulb_yet: This light has no bulb yet.
strings.auto_started: Fullscreen: the lights now follow the screen.
strings.reconnecting_tip: The bulb stopped answering. Lueur keeps trying to reach it.
strings.held_tip: {host} is playing an effect on this light. Lueur waits, and picks it up again as soon as {host} lets go.
strings.held_other_tip: Another app or computer is streaming to this bulb. Lueur waits, and picks it up again as soon as it is free.
strings.take_over_tip: Drive this light from here. The other one waits instead.
strings.e_monitor_missing: Display {subject} is no longer connected. Pick another in Settings.
strings.e_monitors_unavailable: Displays cannot be read right now.
strings.e_light_unbound: This light has no bulb yet.
strings.e_light_following: An effect is playing on this light.
strings.e_light_not_playing: No effect is playing on this light here.
strings.e_invalid_timer: This timer is out of range.
strings.e_no_active_lights: No light with a bulb takes part in effects.
strings.e_audio_unavailable: Lueur cannot hear this computer's sound.
strings.e_audio_device_missing: Lueur cannot find {subject}. Plug it back in, or pick another sound source in Settings.
strings.e_audio_app_closed: Lueur cannot hear {subject}: open it and play something, or pick another sound source in Settings.
strings.e_music_mode_failed: No light answered: {subject}. Are their bulbs powered and on this network?
strings.e_discovery_failed: The network could not be searched.
strings.e_pair_waiting: The button was not pressed in time.
strings.e_cloud_unreachable: Smart Life cannot be reached. Is this computer online?
strings.e_tuya_refused: Smart Life refused. Check the user code and try again.
strings.e_invalid_user_code: This user code is not valid.
strings.e_login_item_failed: Open at login could not be changed.
strings.e_export_failed: The file could not be written.
strings.e_logs_unavailable: The logs folder could not be opened.
strings.e_import_invalid: This file is not a Lueur configuration.
strings.e_device_not_pending: This device is no longer waiting for an answer. Search again.
strings.e_confirm_needs_pairing: This bridge no longer shows the certificate Lueur knows. Pair it again with its button.
strings.e_pair_no_tls: This bridge did not answer over HTTPS, so Lueur did not pair it: its key would have crossed the network unencrypted. Check that it is on, then try again.
strings.e_pair_cert_changed: This bridge shows another certificate than the one Lueur knows for it, so Lueur did not pair it.
strings.unverified_moved: {name} answers at {ip} instead of {known}. Lueur sends it nothing until you confirm it is yours.
strings.unverified_changed: {name} at {ip} shows a different certificate from the one it had when paired. Lueur sends it nothing until you confirm it is yours.
strings.unverified_tip: If you did not move or reset it, another device may be posing as yours: leave it, or pair it again with its button.
strings.unverified_pinned: {name} at {ip} does not show the certificate Lueur knows for it, so it gets nothing. If you reset this bridge, pair it again with its button; otherwise leave it.
strings.credentials_unsealed: Hue, Nanoleaf and Smart Life credentials are stored unencrypted: no system keyring is available.

tuya_added: {n} Smart Life bulb was added to your room.
{n} Smart Life bulbs were added to your room.
tuya_ready: {n} Smart Life bulb is ready. Pick below which light it is, or add it as a new light.
{n} Smart Life bulbs are ready. Pick below which light each one is, or add them all as new lights.
